name: Hilary Crowley
reason: Health rule (borderline, so left out): her own site (hilarycrowley.com, About and In-Person Sessions pages) presents her as an energy medicine practitioner and medical intuitive working inside a family medical practice (Whole Life Health Care, Newington, New Hampshire) as part of its integrative healthcare team for over twenty years; her book is sold as 'Your Natural Prescription for Resilient Health' and her events page bills her as 'Medical Intuitive'. Her main work is healing sessions in a clinical setting, and 'medical' framing is out under the strict rule. What would pass is thin: a Kripalu weekend on intuition (12–14 Mar 2027), remote sessions, a podcast and a TEDx talk. A human may want to reconsider; if kept, base is Newington, New Hampshire (Regional).
